messages:
alex_g: Quick sync — I want to propose an 'ops-sandbox' for a joint perf/W and kernel-tuning run with Cobalt next sprint. Goal: quantify throughput/W with our quantized 13B profile vs their board, isolate kernel diffs, and produce a reproducible playbook.

maria_hw: SGTM. Can we scope the exact acceptance criteria? e.g., target watt/throughput delta that would justify a co-announcement?

alex_g: Good Q. Draft acceptance criteria: 1) >=10% throughput/W improvement vs baseline on at least 2 workloads (chat, batch infer). 2) 95th pctl latency within our SLA for single-request path. 3) Repro script + perf dashboard and signed-off telemetry.

suresh_infra: For kernel-level experiments we'll need a controlled runner set and a config matrix. Proposal: three kernel families (stock, nvfused-opt, our tiling patch) x 2 quantization modes (q4/q8) x batch sizes [1,4,16]. Keep seq len at 1024 for standard.

linh_sre: Also add power profiling constraints: rack-level IPMI + onboard telemetry. We'll tag runs with trace IDs and ship a small telemetry pcap to Cobalt for validation. Alerting: bench failures -> #partnerships-ops-alerts.

alex_g: Nice. I'll own run orchestration + partner coordination. Suresh, can you draft the runner bootstrap and the exact CLI we'll use so partners can replicate?

suresh_infra: Yep. Draft CLI we can use:

```bash
./bench_runner 
  --model redwood-13b-q4 
  --kernel=${KERNEL} 
  --batch=${BATCH} 
  --seq=1024 
  --workload={chat|batch} 
  --trace-id=${TRACE} 
  --power-monitor=ipmi:\10.0.0.5 
  --out=results/${TRACE}.json
```

suresh_infra: We'll also commit a docker image: redwood/bench-runner:ops-sandbox-2026 with the exact kernel modules. That avoids host drift.

maria_hw: For partner visibility, suggest a short README and a minimal checklist: hardware setup, power metering steps, and how to upload results. I can draft that and share with Cobalt.

linh_sre: Ops notes: keep one runner pinned to our telemetry collector and one mirrored on Cobalt for cross-validation. Time sync (PTP) is required for aligning traces.

alex_g: Timeline idea: Week 0 (this week): finalize matrix + image; Week 1: partner lab dry-run; Week 2: 3-day sweep; Week 3: analysis + playbook publish. Is that realistic?

suresh_infra: Tight but doable if partners can allocate 2 boards and one engineering slot for the dry-run. We'll parallelize by kernel family.

bench-bot: smoke: runners registered: runner-ops-01, runner-ops-02; image redwood/bench-runner:ops-sandbox-2026 pulled successfully on runner-ops-01.

maria_hw: I'll ping Cobalt (Cora) now and propose the timeline. Also requesting a short NDA addendum around telemetry sharing.

alex_g: Thanks — action items: (alex) send invite + matrix, (maria) partner comms + NDA, (suresh) image + CLI + artifact commit, (linh) telemetry and alert hooks. Callout: we will produce a short 'co-bench playbook' for marketplace listing if results look good.

maria_hw: One more ask from legal: any co-branded wording needs signoff before mention. Noted.

linh_sre: If any run shows >5% perf/W regression vs our baseline, auto-fail and create a regression ticket. We'll need a small eval harness to check that threshold in CI.

alex_g: Perfect. I'll follow up with a short doc and attach the initial matrix. Expect invite for Monday sync. :thumbsup:
